title: ToggleButton
description: Fiori toggle button: a Button that keeps a pressed state, in every Fiori button design.

usage.summary: Keep a secondary toolbar action visibly on or off.
useWhen: Let users activate or deactivate a toolbar feature such as bold formatting.
Keep the same label and icon in both states; the pressed state communicates activation.
Give icon-only toggles a tooltip and an accessible label.

avoidWhen.when: Trigger an activity or process such as Create, Edit or Save.
Apply an on/off form setting immediately.
Review an independent option before submitting it.
Choose related options within the same view or setting.
